blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Seeing everything Tanzania has in store is something many people dream of. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari adventure looking for Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or time on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania offers all of it. Even better, Your Tanzania Trip can create a custom made itinerary built around all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Need some inspiration? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Many of our clients like to round off an exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of the most beautiful beaches of Zanzibar. Is that something for you as well?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Would you like one of our popular Tanzania itineraries, or a journey shaped around you? Whichever you prefer, we will help you. Come along and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, just as you want it!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: Walking out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, you are greeted with a wide smile by your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide brings you straight to the hotel, so you can relax and enjoy the African atmosphere. On the next day you and your guide start an exclusive, private safari that lets you travel at the pace you like. With a safari jeep all to yourself, you are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: Today is a wonderful relaxing day, that you can spend in whatever way you like. Choose to spend the whole day at the lodge to enjoy the excellent service, sip on refreshing drinks, lounge near the pool, and just engulf yourself in the African vibes surrounding you. Or get to know Arusha through some interesting activities - go for example on a city tour, explore the outskirts of the city by mountain bike, or score your first souvenirs at an exhilarating Maasai market…
blocks.html: Today is a wonderfully restful day, and you can spend it however you wish. Perhaps you stay at the lodge all day, enjoying the excellent service and cool drinks, relaxing beside the pool and soaking up the African surroundings. Or you explore Arusha with some interesting activities - such as a city tour, a mountain bike ride through the outskirts, or hunting for your first souvenirs at a vibrant Maasai market…

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is famous for big groups of elephants and huge numbers of giant baobab trees. Baobabs can grow hundreds of years old, and during the dry season elephants actually use them as a source of water, thanks to a special technique they have for drawing water from the trees. The Tarangire River is also the sole source of water in the dry season, which is why at that time you may see groups of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, along with lots of other animals!

blocks.orig: Gibb's Farm offers the old-age rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, right on the slopes of Ngorongoro Highlands. Walk around on this sanctuary of peace and tranquility, and watch vegetables being harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked, and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees, and herbs provide inspiration for the farm's chefs, who in their turn amaze visitors with a delicious lunch. A little piece of heaven!
blocks.html: At Gibb's Farm you experience the age-old rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, on the slopes of the Ngorongoro Highlands. Stroll around this peaceful, quiet sanctuary and see vegetables being picked, coffee roasted, cows milked and pigs fed. The farm's chefs draw inspiration from the vegetable gardens, herbs and fruit trees, and they in turn delight visitors with a delicious lunch. A small piece of heaven!

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: Ngorongoro Crater, well known around the world, is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. Two million years ago a huge volcano erupted, and that is how the crater was formed. Its fertile lava created a unique ecosystem, which is now home to the highest concentration of animals in the whole of Africa! In the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the views are breathtaking – you won’t know where to look!

blocks.orig: You fly into the Serengeti, where your guide will be waiting for you. This marks the start of your safari in an ecosystem famous for its endless plains, the Great Migration, and one of Africa's highest concentrations of lions and cheetahs.
blocks.html: Your flight takes you into the Serengeti, where your guide is waiting. Here your safari begins, in an ecosystem known for its endless plains, the Great Migration and one of the highest concentrations of lions and cheetahs in Africa.

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park is known everywhere as the place for a safari, above all because of the Great Migration that travels through it. The enormous herds charging across the plains are impressive, and so are the many predators living here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! There are many other beautiful animals as well, and your guide will be glad to look for them with you. Are you ready for this?

blocks.orig: You will take a scenic flight to Arusha, a vibrant city that serves as the gateway to Tanzania's northern safari circuit - located at the base of the towering Mount Meru.
blocks.html: A scenic flight brings you to Arusha, a lively city at the foot of the towering Mount Meru that is the gateway to the northern safari circuit of Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Dive into the world of beads and jewellery in an exclusive two-and-a-half-hour workshop at Shanga, a social enterprise in Arusha. The company employs over thirty, mostly hearing-impaired artisans who create high-quality handmade jewellery, glassware, and homeware with recycled and sustainable materials. Embark on the workshop with a guided tour through the premises, then test your creativity by crafting two pieces of jewellery and trying your hand at glass blowing.
blocks.html: Discover the world of beads and jewellery during an exclusive workshop of two and a half hours at Shanga, a social enterprise in Arusha. More than thirty artisans work there, most of them hearing-impaired, making high-quality handmade jewellery, glassware, and homeware from recycled and sustainable materials. The workshop begins with a guided tour of the premises; then you put your creativity to the test by making two pieces of jewellery and having a go at glass blowing.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax in the lodge a bit longer before heading to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to add a few days to your holiday by going to one of Tanzania's paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on your flight time, you can stay at the lodge and relax a little longer before you travel to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your flight home. Not quite ready to go? You can also extend your holiday by a few days on one of Tanzania's paradise islands, for example Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
